I am passionate about helping others and want to continue building my career in this field. I am looking for an organization where I can bring my experience, compassion, and dedication to the work while earning a salary that provides the financial stability necessary for me to focus fully on my professional responsibilities. In my previous position, I served as a Residential Program Director with Sunrise Community, where I was responsible for overseeing two group homes and supervising a team of approximately 20 staff members. My salary was $45,000 yearly but was raised to $55,000 after 3 months. This role was highly rewarding and provided me with valuable experience supporting individuals with mental health and intellectual disabilities. I found the work especially meaningful because it allowed me to advocate for the individuals we served while ensuring they received appropriate care, support, and services.

During my tenure (July 2024-2025), one of the homes under my supervision was closed, and I was subsequently transferred to Miami to manage two additional residential homes. This transition presented several significant operational challenges, including the need to work directly on the staff floor while simultaneously fulfilling my managerial responsibilities. In addition, there were ongoing operational and compliance concerns within the homes that created potential liabilities.

I made every effort to address these concerns through the appropriate management channels and advocated for the necessary corrective actions. Unfortunately, when several of the issues remained unresolved despite my efforts to bring them to upper management's attention, I ultimately made the difficult decision to leave the organization.

Despite the circumstances surrounding my departure, I remain grateful for the experience and the opportunity to serve individuals with disabilities. The position strengthened my leadership, problem-solving, staff-management, advocacy, and crisis-management skills, all of which continue to shape my approach to working in human services.

September 24, 2026
Hiring Committee
Adolescent Wellness Academy
Dear Hiring Committee:

I am interested in the Clinic Director position with Adolescent Wellness Academy as you prepare to open your first North Carolina location. What caught my attention about this opportunity is that it requires more than strong clinical skills. You are looking for someone who can build a program, develop a team, create a healthy culture, and keep clinical quality and business operations moving in the same direction. That combination reflects the work I have done throughout my career.
I am currently serving contractually as Clinical Director with T. Robinson Family First in Mooresville, North Carolina, where I provide clinical oversight, support staff development and supervision, monitor documentation and quality, and help ensure services remain aligned with Medicaid, managed-care, and regulatory expectations. I also maintain my private practice and consulting work, which keeps me connected to direct clinical care with youth, adults, and families.
My leadership experience is extensive. I built Carolina Family Comprehensive Services from the ground up and led the organization for 13 years, growing it to five regional sites and more than 100 employees while managing clinical quality, operations, compliance, staffing, community partnerships, and a $5 million annual budget. I later served as a Clinical/Executive Director overseeing more than 50 staff and multiple offices, and as an Assistant Health Director with Mecklenburg County Public Health, where I managed programs and partnerships supported by approximately $20 million in grant and county funding.

I appreciate that AWA is looking for a leader who can be supportive while still being clear and accountable. That is how I lead. I believe people do their best work when expectations are clear, feedback is consistent, problems are addressed directly, and staff know their leader is invested in both their growth and the quality of care being provided. I have spent much of my career building teams, developing supervisors and clinicians, improving systems, and helping programs become stronger and more sustainable.

I do not have direct PHP/IOP experience, and I want to be transparent about that. My adolescent experience has been in outpatient and intensive community-based behavioral health services, family work, crisis coordination, clinical supervision, and program leadership. At the same time, I have repeatedly entered new programs and systems, learned the requirements, built the necessary structure, and led teams through implementation and growth. I am confident that experience would translate well as I learn AWA's specific PHP/IOP model and expectations.

I would welcome the opportunity to help establish Adolescent Wellness Academy in North Carolina and build a clinic that families trust, employees are proud to be part of, and the organization can grow from. I am also open to supporting pre-launch planning, recruitment, training, and program development before the full-time January 2027 start date.

Thank you for considering my application. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the position and learn more about AWA's plans for North Carolina.
Sincerely,

Tamikia Greene, Ed.D., LCMHCS, LCAS

I am excited to apply for the Adolescent Mental Health Program Coordinator position with Adolescent Wellness Academy.
